name: mountain-king.ogg
title: File:Musopen - In the Hall Of The Mountain King.ogg
artist: Edvard Grieg (composition, 1875); performed by the Czech National Symphony Orchestra as the Musopen Symphony Orchestra
source: Musopen - https://musopen.org/music/777-peer-gynt-suite-no-1-op-46/ - released into the public domain by the Musopen Kickstarter project
usage: Thinking music while the 30-second clue timer runs. The default track: it starts quiet and builds, so the room hears the time running out without anybody watching the number. Downloaded unedited; the widget only ever plays the opening 30 seconds and fades it out.

name: nachtmusik.ogg
title: File:Mozart K525 Serenade in G Major 1 - Allegro.ogg
artist: Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart (composition, 1787); performance credited on Musopen to the European Archive
usage: Thinking music while the clue timer runs. Bright and familiar - the one to pick for the 100s and 200s, where the timer is about pace rather than pressure. Downloaded unedited.

name: maple-leaf-rag.ogg
title: File:Maple Leaf Rag - played by Scott Joplin 1916 sample.ogg
artist: Scott Joplin (composition, 1899, and the 1916 piano roll performance); roll digitised by pianola.co.nz, re-recorded as audio by Wikimedia user Major Bloodnok
source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Maple_Leaf_Rag_-_played_by_Scott_Joplin_1916_sample.ogg - a 1916 piano roll, public domain in the United States
usage: Thinking music while the clue timer runs. The cheerful one, and the one to use on the trivia categories. Downloaded unedited.

name: badinerie.ogg
title: File:Bach, Johann Sebastian - Suite No.2 in B Minor - X. Badinerie.ogg
artist: Johann Sebastian Bach (composition, BWV 1067); performance credited on Musopen to the European Archive
usage: Thinking music while the clue timer runs. Fast and light, and the shortest file of the four. CC0 rather than public domain by age - the recording is dedicated to the public domain by its uploader, which is not the same thing, so it is recorded here as CC0.
